{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-7s3n","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-wa51: EDHOC TH_4 uses id_cred_i instead of full credential CRED_I","description":"The TH_3 fix correctly switched from `id_cred_r` → `cred_r` (full credential), but TH_4 construction still uses `id_cred_i` at both locations:

1. `python/src/lichen/crypto/edhoc.py:459` (initiator `_create_message_3`):
   `cbor2.dumps(id_cred_i)` — should use full credential CRED_I per RFC 9528 Section 5.4.2

2. `python/src/lichen/crypto/edhoc.py:705` (responder `_process_message_3`):
   `cbor2.dumps(id_cred_i)` — same issue

RFC 9528 defines TH_4 = H(TH_3, PLAINTEXT_3, CRED_I), where CRED_I is the full credential CBOR item (CCS or CWT), not ID_CRED_I (kid, x5t, or CCS). The TH_3 fix correctly adopted `cred_r` for the responder credential; TH_4 should do the same for the initiator credential.

If this implementation uses CCS/RPK where ID_CRED_I = CRED_I by design, please document that explicitly.
